title: Microsoft Copilot: Excel Agent builds charts, summaries and formulas from your data
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing qualifications and documented controls check out. The agent-store visibility statement is unconfirmed for Excel Agent: Learn names Office Agent instead. The licence-assignment checklist step also has no corresponding controls-table row.

claims.claim: Organization-wide agent blocking is in Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents. In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.
